title: Christian Barmore questionable for Patriots, Alijah Vera-Tucker will travel to L.A.

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Christian Barmore questionable for Patriots, Alijah Vera-Tucker will travel to L.A.
sources.description: Patriots defensive tackle Christian Barmore was added to the team's injury report on Friday and his status for Sunday's game against the Chargers is uncertain as a result.
